raw.comments: Repair only `Tablet/FrontTreeOrderedExtension.tex`; preserve its Lean statement, imports, and support structure. First unfold the InitialSegment witness for s in v=s union {n}: show the cutoff cannot lie in s, because the defining equality would then both contain and omit that cutoff, and since v\s={n}, conclude the cutoff is n and every element of s is below n. In the density step, after proving w is strictly longer than s, split w=v from w\ne v. If w=v, use w in F directly to conclude v in PrefixTree. If w\ne v, choose the least element of w\v after the inserted n and explicitly prove InitialSegment(v,w), hence the PrefixTree conclusion. Retain the valid front-membership prefix-freeness argument and the paper reference to lines 1145--1148. Add no helper or structural changes.
